title: CIA approaches Puthoff over Russian psychic research

tellings.quote: they were accurate and so it was when i wrote all that up and circulated around that's when the cia came knocking at my doorstep and they said oh we've been looking for you and i said you know why would i do he said well the russians have been spending millions of dollars at their best institutes with their best people for years

plain: Hal Puthoff, a researcher at the Stanford Research Institute, a research laboratory in California, says that in the early 1970s he wrote up some psychic tests whose results were accurate and circulated the write-up, and soon after the CIA came knocking. He tells Michels the agents said they had been looking for him because the Russians had been spending millions of dollars for years on this kind of research, at their best institutes and with their best people. If so, it would mean the CIA's interest in psychic research began as an answer to a Soviet effort.
